baseline: EnsureA20ON branches to XMMerror, which selects video mode, directly prints XMMERRMSG and loops; XMMERRMSG is generated into MSDOS.CL2 from dos/msdos.skl and usa-ms-dos.msg.
findings: The corresponding target A20 call tests AX and, on zero, reaches a far indirect call at 0x1af95 instead of the baseline direct video-print sequence.
The exact baseline XMMERRMSG text is absent from target IO.SYS; a longer differently worded A20 error occurs at 0x10285. The indirect callee and that text have not been connected.
limitations: The target far pointer provider and complete control flow remain unverified.
Absence of exact bytes does not prove no equivalent differently encoded path exists.
Full kernel data placement and target IO.SYS link remain unresolved.
additional_finding: The A20 zero-result path and BIOS error entry share compatible selectors 0,1,2,3, suggesting a connection; pointer initialization is still unproven.
